description_en: Queries the detailed information about tasks of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-active-operation-task --biz-region cn-shanghai --task-type rds_apsaradb_ha --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTask

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

If you set the Region parameter to all, all tasks created within your Alibaba Cloud account are queried. In this case, you must set the taskType parameter to all
parameters.help_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域 ID，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html查询。all代表查询该用户下所有的任务，此参数为all， taskType也必须为all
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: master-replica switchover

rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration

rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor version update
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。

取值来源https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639186.html。

传入all代表查询该用户下所有的任务，此参数为all时， region也必须为all
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the historical tasks.

Default value: 0. Valid values:

0: returns the current task.

1: returns the historical tasks
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回历史任务，取值：

0：默认值，返回当前任务。
1：返回历史任务
parameters.name: is_history

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Specify a value greater than 10. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数，取值需大于 10，默认值为 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于 0 且不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 运维任务创建时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

DbType.description_en: The database type of the instance

Deadline.description_en: The deadline before which the time to preform the task can be modified. The time in UTC is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
Deadline.description_zh: 运维任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the task was modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 运维任务修改时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

PrepareInterval.description_en: The required preparation period between the task start time and the switchover time. The time is displayed in the HH:mm:ss format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 运维任务开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间，格式为HH:mm:ss

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task was preformed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 运维任务执行的时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

Status.description_en:
The state of the task. Valid values:

2: The task is waiting for users to specify a switchover time.

3: The task is waiting to be performed.

4: The task is being performed. If the task is in this state, the ModifyActiveOperationTask operation cannot be called to modify the scheduled switchover time.

5: The task is performed.

6: The task fails.

7: The task is canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，返回值：
2：等待用户指定时间。
3：等待处理。
4：处理中。进入此状态后，不可修改计划切换时间。
5：成功。
6：失败。
7：已取消

SwitchTime.description_en: The time when the system performs the switchover operation. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
SwitchTime.description_zh: 运维任务切换时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）

TaskType.description_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: master-replica switchover

rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration

rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor version update

all: all types
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型，返回值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
